name: Summer at Shady Hill School
description_short: A six-week summer day camp at Shady Hill School in Cambridge for children ages 4 to 14, open to the public. Children are grouped by grade and each session has a theme, with arts, STEM and PE activities designed by Shady Hill teachers.
swim_waterfront_notes: No swimming: the school has no swimming facilities. Campers have daily water play on an inflatable water slide and other water activities.

special_needs_notes: Families are invited to call the Auxiliary Programs Office before registering to discuss a child's needs; the program says it is not a medical or therapeutic program. Children must be toilet trained.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds minus deposits are available until May 15, 2026; after that tuition is not refundable, with case-by-case exceptions by the Director of Auxiliary Programs. No refunds for missed days, or for a child withdrawn for safety reasons.
